purpose: Deterministically service clean-worker experiment requests and terminal candidates for the non-claim-bearing screening stage without exposing evaluator-only oracle files to workers.
control_rules: The control evaluator may read the assigned run-state file and the exact evaluator oracle bound to its fixture.
The control evaluator never copies the oracle document, expected hypothesis, interpretation hints, or unused experiment results into worker-visible state.

For WAITING_EXTERNAL, publish only the exact requested experiment result payload plus its content hash into the assigned run-state file, append a CONTROL_EXTERNAL_RESULT event, clear pending_external, and set READY_TO_RESUME.

For TERMINAL_CANDIDATE, score with the deterministic objective evaluator and publish only validator_id, pass/fail, normalized score, violation codes, and a commitment/evidence reference. Do not publish the expected answer.
If the candidate fails, set READY_TO_RESUME with exact violation codes and no hidden-answer disclosure; the worker may continue if its arm/protocol permits.
If the candidate passes, set COMPLETED and record completion metadata.
Never repair worker reasoning or choose experiments on the worker's behalf.
Never service a request for an experiment absent from the worker-visible catalog.
Never service a run whose source checkpoint, fixture blob SHA, arm, or generation no longer matches durable state.
Control-side oracle access creates no execution authority and authorizes no production mutation.

forbidden_publication: interpretation_hint beyond the exact requested result payload if present

screening_claim_boundary: A successful screening run establishes protocol/harness operability only. It does not count toward executor-quality conclusions.
